articleTitle: Determination of the danger of the occurrence of stray currents in electrified DC urban transport
abstract: Electrified urban transport occupies an important part of the life of every modern society. This paper describes some of the negative processes caused by electrified rail urban transport. Paper deals with overview of the measurement types related to controlling the leakage current from the rail network in ground electric transport (tram). Results of measurements carried out at the “Yunak” traction substation are presented.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of MTP and TORA routing protocols
abstract: The world is changing. Everything is evolving, technologies too. The future promises a cleaner and nicer world thanks to ITS (Intelligent transport systems). The day is approaching when autonomous cars will be driving on the streets. The VANET network, which is part of the ITS, was designed for this purpose. The main idea is to increase road safety. Routing protocols are very important to any network because the connection establishment depends on them. In the present work, two routing protocols used in VANET are examined and compared. These are MTP and TORA.

articleTitle: Control of the modes of architectural and artistic lighting systems
abstract: The article gives a general assessment of architectural and artistic lighting, developed a methodology and model for the quantitative and qualitative assessment of artistic lighting. An approach was proposed and the structure of the control system for architectural and artistic lighting objects was developed as an integral part of the Smart-Light system for power supply and lighting of the city.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient and Economically Effective Reconstruction of the Lighting System of a Lecture Hall
abstract: Energy efficiency of lighting systems is nowadays inevitably interconnected with LEDs as sources of light. The current paper discusses the opportunity for energy efficient and at the same time economically effective reconstruction of a lecture hall at the Technical University of Sofia. Several variations of the lighting system are simulated and estimated economically including retrofit replacement of the fluorescent T8 tubes and keeping the luminaires places and housing, replacement of the luminaires, but keeping their arrangement and entire replacement and rearrangement of the luminaires. The LENI factor is estimated for each case and economical appraisal by means of NPV and LCC methods is carried out.

Author Keywords: replacement of fluorescent with LED luminaires

articleTitle: Comparative Study of the Photometric Characteristics and the Efficiency of a Linear LED Luminaire with Prismatic and Opaque Diffusers
abstract: Comparative study of the photometric characteristics and efficiency of an indoor application linear LED luminaire with three variants of the optical system without secondary optic, with prismatic diffuser and with opaque diffuser, is done in this paper. The results for the measured with a goniophotometer system located in a dark room laboratory, specially created for such types of measurements, maximum luminous intensity, beam angle, total luminous flux, efficiency luminaire, luminance at vertical angular zones and light distribution for the three variants of the linear LED luminaire are presented. The efficiency losses in the secondary optical system with both diffusers of the tested linear LED luminaire are shown. Comparative lighting calculations of the linear LED luminaire with and without a secondary optical system in an office room are done. Conclusions and recommendations regarding the realized photometric indicators, glare and achieved indoor lighting energy efficiency of the linear LED luminaire secondary optical system with both diffusers are done.

articleTitle: Dynamics in Lighting- Post Covid, Flexibility and Adaptiveness in Residential Spaces/Office Spaces
abstract: Initiating from recent pandemic conditions, this study deals with the influence of light on the psychology of people during a typical working day at small scale residential spaces, aiming at delivering strategic design of anthropocentric lighting for visual, mental and biological health.

articleTitle: Influence the Metamerism to Color Rendering in Through Video Path
abstract: The paper deals with the issues of metamers in the end-to-end video path, emphasizes the importance of taking this parameter into account in the overall assessment of color rendering. Measurements were made based on spectral distributions of ISO and 6-, 8- and 11-channel LED luminaire presented by Babak Zandi and others. The magnitude of the influence on the color rendering of the scene object when using LED lighting sources is studied. A variant of considering distortions based on the spectral analysis of the color of the scene object and the light source when transmitting color through the end-to-end video path is proposed. The issues of the spectral transmission index by the end-to-end video path are also touched upon

articleTitle: Comparison of electrical parameters of LED luminaires for outdoor lighting in an industrial plant
abstract: The report presents the study of the electrical parameters of outdoor lighting systems in an industrial enterprise. We carried out the research in two workshops in an actual industrial enterprise. Its production is related to cutting and making furniture. The lighting systems are built with different lighting fixtures with corresponding power and number. The parameters are measured with a network analyzer and with appropriate equipment - current transformers, laptops, etc., necessary equipment. The measurements for the various parameters were carried out for 1 to 2 months for each workshop. The measurement intervals are set to 5 minutes. All the requirements of the current power quality standards (EN 61000 series of measures) and the regulatory documents in this field have been met. The obtained data are summarized and presented in the appropriate graphical and tabular form. The relevant conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Utilization of photovoltaic installation to optimize electric vehicle’s loads
abstract: A discussion about possibilities of utilization of photovoltaic installation to optimize electric vehicle’s loads is presented in this paper. The purpose of the photovoltaic installation is to feed the low voltage loads inside the cabin of the vehicle. This can enable for a 12 V “start-stop” battery with lower capacity to be used. Thus, lowering some of the costs and expenses.

articleTitle: Control and Compensation of Reactive Power of Road Tunnels
abstract: A discussion about control and compensation of reactive power of road tunnels with perspective of supplying electricity by a PV installation is presented in this paper. Road tunnels are a significant part of road infrastructure and a significant power consumer. As modern lighting installation is primarily comprised of LED’s, which operate with a non-linear V-A characteristic, a proper control of reactive power is mandatory.

articleTitle: Color Consistency of Retrofit LED Lamps
abstract: As it has been ever since the artificial lighting has been introduced, a lot of “unknowns” have been brought with the development of solid-state lighting. The current paper presents an investigation of the color shift of the light of LED retrofit lamps, operating at normal operational conditions for a period of three months. For description of the color consistency of the test lamps the correlated color temperature CCT and Duv and standard deviation color match SDCM have been chosen. The change of the spectra and color rendering are also estimated, CRI, CQS, GAI and TM - 30 Rf and Rg are measured and analysed.

Author Keywords: color shift of solid state products

articleTitle: Review of Methodologies for Life Cycle Assessment of Power Electronic Devices
abstract: This paper reviews basic methodologies for estimation of the life cycle of the different power electronic devices. Such a study is necessary in order to assess the residual life of various machines, systems and equipment with a view to the use of semiconductor components in them. In this way the economic justification for their purchase, modernization or utilization is modeled and optimized.

articleTitle: New Advances in Development of Clinical Trial Management Systems
abstract: The electronic systems for medical data take bigger and bigger place and importance in our life. One important part of them are Medical trial systems. Those systems give possibility to doctors, patients and hospitals to elaborate and make the treatment more precise. The continuous process of development of new functionalities makes those systems much more useful. A lot of solutions are presented on the market. In the presented research is made an attempt to present the process of development of such a type of software. All the data entered can be easily via them processed. The importance is also in this that CTS save working time and can reduce the prices for hospitals and patients.

articleTitle: Light Intensity Influence on Stereolithographic 3D Printing Curing Time
abstract: In this work, estimation of light intensity influence on stereolithographic 3D printing curing time is presented. Testing method is applied for photopolymer resin material used for SLA 3D printing. Photopolymer samples are treated with 405 nm UV LEDs array, with different time durations and light intensity levels. Final hardness of the test samples has been estimated and compared. Results could be used for optimization of SLA technology, subject to optimal curing time and curing light intensity. Also energy efficiency and material efficiency could be improved by obtained data.

articleTitle: Multicomponent LED Lighting Installation on Main Machinery Room of Electric Plant
abstract: The report presents the study of the technical and economic parameters of a multi-component LED lighting system of an electrical plant.In the machine rooms of the power plants, a variety of activities are carried out, containing the execution of specific visual works. Performed: general monitoring of processes; monitoring by operators of all facilities; tours and inspection of facilities; laboratory measurements and control; installation, dismantling and repair to maintain the facilities. Mixed lighting should be implemented in the main sections of the engine room. In some of the constituent rooms and sections, there is no access to daylight natural lighting.The aim of the present work is to determine the technical and economic parameters of a multi-component lighting system of a main engine room of a thermal power plant, realizing high energy efficiency.It is proposed to replace the conventional lighting fixtures which is with metal halide lamps with modern LED lighting fixtures with high efficiency.As a result of the proposed replacement, an almost two-fold reduction of the installed power has been achieved. Savings of electrical energy and reduction of greenhouse gases have been realized.The relevant conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Voltage Equalizer for Two Batteries/Ultracapacitors — Control System and Practical Realization
abstract: This article offers a way to implement the control system of two boost converters connected between energy storage elements (batteries or ultracapacitors) and designed to balance the voltages on the elements. The monitoring and control system has been studied by computer simulation with PSim program, and the results at different voltage ratios are presented. The practical realization of the entire device is described.

articleTitle: Management of street lighting by relative value of the rate of change of natural light
abstract: the report describes methods and means of street lighting management.Based on the change of natural illuminance E at dusk and dawn and analysis of the derivative E’ over time (dE/dt), an algorithm is proposed for turning on/off devices for local (by cassettes) and individual (by luminaries) control of the street lighting systems.

Author Keywords: photo relays and clocks for street lighting management

articleTitle: Aspects of Photometric Calculation and Monitoring of Parameters Related to an Interior Lighting Installation
abstract: In this paper, the authors present a systematized and clear methodology for calculation and monitoring using specialized equipment of direct illuminances produced by linear light sources. A room with the destination of an academic didactic laboratory was chosen as a case study. The electric lighting of the room is achieved by means of two types of luminaires equipped with tubular fluorescent lamps with a power of 18 W and 36 W respectively.

Author Keywords: dedicated software to HD450 specialized luxmeter

articleTitle: Hybrid System for Supplying Smart Home
abstract: In the current paper a hybrid system for supplying a smart home is presented. The hybrid system consists of photovoltaic and supercapacitor. The model of the system is realized in PSim environment. In the model of the PV system the solar irradiance and the ambient temperature are considered. These parameters significantly increase the accuracy of the developed model.

articleTitle: Modernization of existing street lighting systems in small settlements
abstract: The report outlines good engineering practices to reduce street lighting (SL) costs following the latest unexpected electricity price hike in Europe. The first measure was to reduce energy consumption for street lighting at night - by switching the lights to lower power when traffic is low. The second measure is the prevention of energy theft from SL lines in settlements remote from the municipal center. The last measure requires more time, but is very promising - construction of photovoltaic power plants (PVPP) on municipal buildings for the needs of SL. An energy payment model is applied, which is advantageous for both parties (Electricity Distribution Company/EDC/ and the Municipality) - the energy purchased by the municipality for SL at night is at the same price at which the EDC buys the energy produced by the municipal PV power plants during the day.

articleTitle: Creative Lighting Solutions for Ski Slopes & Resorts
abstract: Artistic-architectural lighting is the most representative, impressive, and aesthetic part of the night space of winter sports complexes. Artistic lighting in combination with sports lighting in accordance with the specified lighting classes described in the regulatory requirements creates a prerequisite for an exciting and safe night experience.

articleTitle: Commercial shop window lighting design: Capturing the gaze of passers-by and creating the desire to consume
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate how the lighting of a commercial shop window can capture the gaze of the passers-by and create a desire to consume. Lighting invites the passer-by to see the shop window and to experience emotions. More specifically, the study focuses on the design of lighting and how it affects the structure, organization and atmosphere of a window display so that customers are attracted to the store through the AIDA method (Awareness, Interest, Desire, Action). The relation between lighting, perception of space and consumer’s psychology are explored in order to create an atmosphere that will cause reactions and evoke emotions. A virtual window space was designed as a case study with different lighting scenarios based on the principles of Richard Kelly. A questionnaire was formed and distributed to people of various ages and backgrounds in order to investigate whether lighting design can affect the psychology of the passers-by and arise consumer’s desire to enter the store. The results focus on the four parameters of the AIDA Model: a) how fast can the lighting of a shop window attract the eye of a passer-by (Awareness), b) whether lighting can direct the gaze to a specific point in the shop window (Interest), c) the relationship between lighting and emotion, i.e. what emotion can be provoked to the passer-by with each lighting technique applied in the studied window (Desire) and d) which lighting design techniques are more likely to make people enter the store (Action)

articleTitle: Natural light and architectural synthesis: the experience of residential space
abstract: The present study analyzes the use of natural light in architectural synthesis through the field of phenomenological architectural theory. It focuses on residential buildings, exploring the different ways natural light affects the dynamics and internal organization of space. This exploration is conducted taking into account the effect of natural light in the way that people interact with architectural space and the formation of their personal-subjective spatial experience. The study concludes that natural light can be used in architectural design to create complex, dynamic living spaces and enhance the spatial experience of residential architecture.

articleTitle: Device for Prevention of Unregulated Connections to Street Lighting Lines in Small Settlements
abstract: The report describes an engineering solution to reduce the costs of street lighting in a municipality by preventing energy theft from street lighting lines in settlements remote from the municipal center.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Shamir’s Secret Sharing
abstract: The aim of the project is to study, analyze and research different security models. The main goal is to propose a solution that checks authenticity by addressing different cipher-suites, and adding more optimizations specifi-cally relevant to secretly parsing session data. The methods are based on Shamir’s Secret Sharing and AES with Galois/Counter Mode (AES-GCM) which provides both authenticated encryption and the ability to check the integrity and authentication of additional authenticated data that is sent in the clear.

articleTitle: Obtaining Nanoparticles by Underwater Laser Ablation – A Brief Review
abstract: This research examines various methods of producing nanoparticles. The comparison and preferences of various laser parameters based on their classification and characteristics are discussed. The main objective of this study is to reveal the dominant laser parameters for the laser ablation process to generate nanoparticles in aqueous media. The method of pulsed laser ablation in liquid to produce nanoparticles is explained in detail. The paper is divided into several main parts, starting with a brief description of various methods of nanoparticle generation and followed by how basic laser parameters and factors affect the laser ablation process. The review also discusses some results on laser ablation of nanoparticles obtained from different materials such as silver, zinc, palladium, and titanium as a function of changing the laser processing parameters of the materials. The study for understanding the process, in brief, is important as nanoparticles could be generated to be used in medicine and pharmaceuticals.
